name: PR416 rolling transition probe

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr416-mechanism-census
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/pr416-rolling-transition-probe.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  rolling-transition:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - label: pinned-main
            ref: 1bad655f5826070d1e29f54a845cdf2c549f66bc
          - label: pr416-control
            ref: 07dcc670fed1ecc6aa32e9711d4bc8830c0ec2ad

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ matrix.ref }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install rolling transition probe
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git fetch origin evidence/pr416-mechanism-census
          git show origin/evidence/pr416-mechanism-census:.github/evidence/Pr416RollingTransitionProbeTests.cs > src/match-engine/tests/Pr416RollingTransitionProbeTests.cs

      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Generate projects and restore
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln

      - name: Run rolling transition probe
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts/pr416-rolling-transition-${{ matrix.label }}
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj \
            --no-restore \
            --filter "Name=MeasureRollingTransitions" \
            --logger "console;verbosity=detailed" \
            --logger "trx;LogFileName=pr416-rolling-transition-${{ matrix.label }}.trx" \
            --results-directory artifacts/pr416-rolling-transition-${{ matrix.label }} \
            2>&1 | tee artifacts/pr416-rolling-transition-${{ matrix.label }}/console.log

      - name: Upload transition evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr416-rolling-transition-${{ matrix.label }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: artifacts/pr416-rolling-transition-${{ matrix.label }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
